title: Top K Frequent Words

monster.name: Lexicon Shade
monster.title: Sorter of Lexical Frequencies
monster.defeatQuote: Ties were broken alphabetically with custom comparator sorting!

description: Given an array of strings `words` and an integer `k`, return the `k` most frequent strings sorted by frequency from highest to lowest, breaking ties by lower alphabetical order.
starterCode:
def topKFrequentWords(words: list[str], k: int) -> list[str]:
    pass
solutionCode:
def topKFrequentWords(words: list[str], k: int) -> list[str]:
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(words)
    sorted_words = sorted(counts.keys(), key=lambda w: (-counts[w], w))
    return sorted_words[:k]
